# kb-search (Codex CLI entry)

This is the Codex entry point for the FUSION `kb-search` skill. **It is a pointer, not the skill.** The full protocol, including every rule, failure mode and verified example, is in `SKILL.md` next to this file.

Codex does not inline markdown imports ([openai/codex#17401](https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/17401)), so nothing below is a substitute for reading it. **Read `SKILL.md` with your file-read tool before acting on this skill**, and do not answer from this summary alone.

## When this skill applies

Search FUSION's offline literature knowledge base (kb-wiki): 61,059 arXiv nucl-th paper pages with digests, 108 PhySH topic pages, a 724k-edge citation graph, and typed semantic relations. Use for 查文献, 搜文献, 知识库, 谁引用了这篇, find papers about X, who cites this, cited-by, related work, literature survey, has anyone done X, offline literature search. Works with plain grep and awk, no network, no API key. A miss here is not proof that no paper exists.
